items.title: app.del() removed
items.summary: Express 5 no longer supports the app.del() function. Use app.delete() instead.

fix.instruction: Replace app.del(path, handler) with app.delete(path, handler) throughout the file.

citation.quote: Express 5 no longer supports the app.del() function. If you use this function, an error is thrown. For registering HTTP DELETE routes, use the app.delete() function instead.

items.title: res.send(status) removed
items.summary: Express 5 no longer supports res.send(statusCode) where status is a number. Use res.sendStatus(code) instead.

citation.quote: Express 5 no longer supports the signature res.send(status), where status is a number. Instead, use the res.sendStatus(statusCode) function

items.title: res.send(body, status) removed
items.summary: Express 5 no longer supports res.send(obj, status). Use res.status(code).send(body) instead.

citation.quote: Express 5 no longer supports the signature res.send(obj, status). Instead, set the status and then chain it to the res.send() method like this: res.status(status).send(obj).

items.title: res.json(obj, status) removed
items.summary: Express 5 no longer supports res.json(obj, status). Use res.status(code).json(obj) instead.

citation.quote: Express 5 no longer supports the signature res.json(obj, status). Instead, set the status and then chain it to the res.json() method like this: res.status(status).json(obj).

items.title: res.sendfile() removed
items.summary: Express 5 replaced res.sendfile() with the camel-cased res.sendFile().

citation.quote: The res.sendfile() function has been replaced by a camel-cased version res.sendFile() in Express 5.

items.title: res.redirect('back') removed
items.summary: Express 5 removed the magic string 'back' in res.redirect() and res.location(). Use req.get('Referrer') || '/' instead.

fix.instruction: Replace res.redirect('back') with res.redirect(req.get('Referrer') || '/'). Replace res.location('back') with res.location(req.get('Referrer') || '/').

citation.quote: Express 5 no longer supports the magic string back in the res.redirect() and res.location() methods. Instead, use the req.get('Referrer') || '/' value to redirect back to the previous page.

items.title: req.param(name) removed
items.summary: Express 5 removed req.param(name). Use req.params, req.body, or req.query instead.

fix.instruction: Replace req.param('name') with req.params.name, req.body.name, or req.query.name as appropriate for the context.

citation.quote: This potentially confusing and dangerous method of retrieving form data has been removed. You will now need to specifically look for the submitted parameter name in the req.params, req.body, or req.query object.

items.title: Singular accepts helpers removed
items.summary: req.acceptsCharset(), req.acceptsEncoding(), req.acceptsLanguage() removed. Use pluralized forms.

fix.instruction: Replace req.acceptsCharset() with req.acceptsCharsets(), req.acceptsEncoding() with req.acceptsEncodings(), req.acceptsLanguage() with req.acceptsLanguages().

citation.quote: req.acceptsCharset() is replaced by req.acceptsCharsets(). req.acceptsEncoding() is replaced by req.acceptsEncodings(). req.acceptsLanguage() is replaced by req.acceptsLanguages().

items.title: Optional route params :id? not valid
items.summary: Express 5 does not support optional route params using '?'. Use brace form instead.

fix.instruction: Replace /:param? with /:param{.:ext} or equivalent brace form per path-to-regexp v8.

citation.quote: The optional character ? is no longer supported, use braces instead.

items.title: Bare * wildcard route not valid
items.summary: Express 5 requires named wildcards. Replace /* with /*splat.

fix.instruction: Replace bare /* wildcard with /*splat (or another named wildcard).

citation.quote: The wildcard * must have a name, matching the behavior of parameters :, use /*splat instead of /*

items.title: Regex-ish route strings not supported
items.summary: Express 5 does not support regex characters in route strings. Use explicit RegExp or named params.

fix.instruction: Replace regex-like route string patterns with an array of explicit paths or with named params.

items.title: express.urlencoded() default for extended changed
items.summary: Express 5 defaults extended to false in urlencoded(). Pass explicitly if you need true.

fix.instruction: Add extended: true or extended: false explicitly to express.urlencoded().

citation.quote: The express.urlencoded method makes the extended option false by default.

items.title: Minimum Node.js version raised to 18
items.summary: Express 5 requires Node.js 18 or higher. The engines field and any CI node version must be bumped.

fix.instruction: Set the engines.node range in package.json to >=18 so it satisfies the Express 5 minimum runtime.

citation.quote: Express 5 requires Node.js version 18 or higher.

items.testExpectation: None: the engines field does not affect test outcomes.

fix.instruction: This pattern should never appear in real code. If found, review manually.
